name: WisePIM Public API
description: Manage your WisePIM catalogue, prompts and knowledge, and launch enrichment, translation and bulk jobs. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer wpk_…`; create keys under Settings → API keys. Each key is bound to one project and to the scopes it was created with.
